AuthorizedProjectionContent.title: AuthorizedProjectionContent
AuthorizedProjectionContent.description: The immutable content of one authorized projection: the canonical object identity (id + digest, never minted), the policy revision and decision digests it was computed under, the subject/action, and the sorted entry set (released fields + redaction markers).

TenantId.title: TenantId
TenantId.description: Opaque tenant identity: "tenant:" followed by a lowercase slug.

PolicyRevisionRef.title: PolicyRevisionRef
PolicyRevisionRef.description: Reference to the exact projection-policy revision a projection was computed under (content-addressed).

PolicyId.title: PolicyId
PolicyId.description: One projection policy id: policy:<slug> (opaque, provider-neutral).

PositiveInteger.title: PositiveInteger
PositiveInteger.description: A positive safe integer (policy revisions and binding indexes are 1-based).

ProjectionSubject.title: ProjectionSubject
ProjectionSubject.description: The subject of one projection: principal id + kind (human/agent/service — service-to-service follows the same path), plus the role and/or agent-task class the policy rows bind to.

RoleId.title: RoleId
RoleId.description: One principal role id: role:<slug> (opaque; roles are caller vocabulary).

AgentTaskClass.title: AgentTaskClass
AgentTaskClass.description: One agent task class: task-class:<slug> (the class of work an agent task performs; task classes get their own, narrower policy rows).

TaskProjectionContext.title: TaskProjectionContext
TaskProjectionContext.description: Agent task projection context: the task class whose policy row applies plus the task object scope (sorted work-package/activity ids the task references).

WorkPackageId.title: WorkPackageId
WorkPackageId.description: Opaque work-package identity: "work-package:" followed by a lowercase slug.

ActivityIdMirror.title: ActivityIdMirror
ActivityIdMirror.description: One W036 activity id (mirrored grammar): activity:<slug>. Pinned by runtime parity against @epoch/solution-delivery.

ProjectionEntry.title: ProjectionEntry
ProjectionEntry.description: One projection entry: a released field (value by reference) or a typed redaction marker (field path + policy clause + redaction class).

ReleasedField.title: ReleasedField
ReleasedField.description: One released field: the concrete walk path and the canonical value, passed through BY REFERENCE (same value, same digest).

RedactionMarker.title: RedactionMarker
RedactionMarker.description: One redaction marker: the field path struck by a policy clause, with the redaction class (field path + policy clause + redaction class; never the value).

PolicyClauseRef.title: PolicyClauseRef
PolicyClauseRef.description: The policy clause behind one redaction: the exact policy revision and the binding row that struck the field.

Timestamp.title: Timestamp
Timestamp.description: UTC instant in canonical form YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.mmmZ (exactly three fractional digits, Z suffix).

PrincipalId.title: PrincipalId
PrincipalId.description: Opaque acting principal: "principal:" followed by a lowercase slug (W009 identity grammar).
